inputs: Step/message/progress/wizard callbacks; optional module init and load callbacks.
preconditions: Utility/path initialization precedes startup; manager singleton creation assumes there is no active runtime. Failure-safe partial cleanup is a later gap, not a guarantee of this function.
effects: Records an existing RUNNING flag as unclean shutdown, otherwise attempts flag creation without checking its boolean result. Creates process singleton managers in source order; optional module-init callback runs before settings load. Loads settings/favorites, free-slot matcher and localization; a pending wizard runs only when its callback exists, then clears WIZARD_PENDING. Loads configured language, certificates, hash database, queue, share, ignore and recents; initializes GeoIP only when GET_USER_COUNTRY is set; starts connectivity. Optional module-load callback runs after data/connectivity; queued post-load callbacks then run in insertion order.
errors: HashManager::startup HashException is caught and rethrown as default Exception, despite the header comment mentioning AbortException. The function has no general catch, rollback or singleton cleanup; exceptions from other loaders/module/post-load callbacks propagate and can leave partially initialized state.
behavior.completion: Returns after the complete DCPlusPlus.cpp:70-187 sequence, module-load callback and post-load callbacks. Return is not a guarantee of restart or rollback safety.
behavior.cancellation: No cancellation token or cooperative abort branch in this entry point.
resources: RUNNING flag and writable profile; settings, localization/language file, certificates, hash/queue/share stores, optional GeoIP database and connectivity resources.

ownership_evidence: Core managers are process-global singletons; these functions do not create an independently owned runtime instance. Callback arguments are value-owned for the call; StartupLoader borrows progress/message callback arguments while startup is executing.
threading_evidence: The entry-point body executes on the caller thread without a global lifecycle lock. Started managers have their own workers; concurrent or repeated runtime calls are not established safe.
records.proposed_bridge_requirement: Preserve startup ordering and translate exceptions; do not promise retry safety without cleanup evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.then: module initialization precedes settings load; module-load runs after connectivity, followed by post-load callbacks in insertion order.

Constructor StartupLoader: StartupLoader(const StepFunction &, const ProgressFunction &, const MessageFunction &) [void (const StepFunction &, const ProgressFunction &, const MessageFunction &)]

evidence_refs: Binary symbol/runtime evidence not inspected for this operation.

inputs: Exact callback/string/member signatures are retained in upstream_symbols.
effects: StartupLoader copies stepF but stores const references to progressF/messageF. Its postLoadTasks vector starts empty, owns moved Callback values, and getPostLoadTasks returns a borrowed const vector reference. addPostLoadTask appends without locking or removal; startup executes each callback after moduleLoadF, in insertion order. StartupLoadCallback borrows a mutable loader; ShutdownUnloadCallback borrows mutable step/progress callback values for the synchronous shutdown call.
errors: Methods marked noexcept have no recoverable error translation; a failure escaping such a method terminates.
behavior.completion: Synchronous state access/mutation; deferred loader callback execution occurs in the startup post-load loop.

ownership_evidence: stepF and stored task values are owned by StartupLoader; progressF/messageF and getPostLoadTasks result are borrowed. Callback captures and borrowed values must survive their use; loader itself is stack-local to startup.
threading_evidence: No locking in helper storage; adding while reading/executing the task vector is not synchronized. Startup serially executes its post-load iteration on the caller thread.
records.proposed_bridge_requirement: Keep helper storage and borrowed C++ references private; apply the concrete behavior through lifecycle/host configuration where required.

acceptance_scenarios.given: A loader holding live progress/message callbacks receives tasks A then B
acceptance_scenarios.when: startup reaches its post-load loop after moduleLoadF
acceptance_scenarios.then: A executes before B; getPostLoadTasks exposes the same owned tasks without transferring their lifetime.

records.surface_rationale: Source-backed lifecycle orchestration helper; preserve behavior through the owning runtime/configuration contract rather than automatically expose a C++ helper object.

evidence_refs: Binary symbol/runtime evidence not inspected for this operation.

inputs: Exact callback/string/member signatures are retained in upstream_symbols.
preconditions: pop_front requires nonempty deque; returned getParams reference is invalidated by owner destruction.
effects: Owns an initially empty deque of parameter strings. addParam ignores empty values and exact case-sensitive duplicates, preserving insertion order. hasParam uses exact comparison and optionally checks the index of the first match (default -1 means any index). removeParam removes the first case-insensitive full/key-prefix match and returns whether a match was removed; getValue returns the first matching value after = or nullopt using the source key-prefix comparison. formatParams joins values with spaces and optionally adds a leading space; getParams returns a borrowed const deque; size reads count; pop_front removes the first element without an empty check.
errors: Methods marked noexcept have no recoverable error translation; a failure escaping such a method terminates.
behavior.completion: Synchronous state access/mutation; deferred loader callback execution occurs in the startup post-load loop.

ownership_evidence: Deque owns strings; optional getValue and formatParams results are owned values; getParams returns a reference valid only while its owner/storage remains valid.
threading_evidence: No internal locking; host serializes mutation and borrowed reads. pop_front requires a nonempty deque.
records.proposed_bridge_requirement: Keep helper storage and borrowed C++ references private; apply the concrete behavior through lifecycle/host configuration where required.
